description: A benchmarking script for the AgentField Python SDK, measuring initialization time, handler registration, memory consumption, cold start, and request latency.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: Data class for statistical measures such as mean, stddev, min, max, and percentiles.

methods.name: Stats calculate_stats(data: list[float])
methods.description: Calculates statistical metrics from a list of float data points.

methods.name: list[float] benchmark_agent_init(iterations: int, warmup: int, verbose: bool)
methods.description: Measures the time to initialize the Agent without handlers over multiple iterations.

methods.name: list[float] benchmark_handler_registration(num_handlers: int, iterations: int, warmup: int, verbose: bool)
methods.description: Measures the time to register handlers with an existing Agent, over multiple iterations.

methods.name: list[float] benchmark_agent_memory(iterations: int, warmup: int, verbose: bool)
methods.description: Measures memory usage of the Agent without handlers over multiple iterations.

methods.name: list[float] benchmark_handler_memory(num_handlers: int, iterations: int, warmup: int, verbose: bool)
methods.description: Measures memory usage of handlers only (excluding Agent overhead) over multiple iterations.

methods.name: list[float] benchmark_cold_start(iterations: int, warmup: int, verbose: bool)
methods.description: Measures time taken for a full agent startup plus first handler invocation.

methods.name: list[float] benchmark_request_processing(num_handlers: int, num_requests: int, verbose: bool)
methods.description: Measures request processing latency by invoking handlers asynchronously.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function orchestrating all benchmarks and reporting results.
